title: Final ν
about: The masculine *τον* always keeps its ν. The words *την, στην, αυτήν, δεν, μην* keep it only before a vowel or before *κ, π, τ, ξ, ψ* and the pairs *γκ, μπ, ντ, τσ, τζ*; before any other consonant (*β, γ, δ, ζ, θ, λ, μ, ν, ρ, σ, φ, χ*) it drops: *τη Μαρία*, *στη θάλασσα*, *μη φύγεις*. With *δεν* the full form is also accepted before other consonants (*δεν θέλω*), but *δε* before a vowel or *κ, π, τ…* is a mistake.

items.en: I'm looking for the classroom door.

errs.why: *π* is one of the letters that keep the ν: *την πόρτα*.

items.en: We're going to Patras on Saturday.

errs.why: *στην* before *π* keeps the ν: *στην Πάτρα*, *στην Κρήτη*, *στην Τήνο*.

items.en: I don't know where the museum is.

errs.why: Before *ξ* the ν stays: *δεν ξέρω*.

items.en: I saw Maria at the supermarket.

errs.why: Before *μ* the ν drops: *τη Μαρία*.

items.en: I love my (tom)cat.

errs.why: The masculine article *τον* always keeps its ν: *τον γάτο*, *τον φίλο*. *Το γάτο* confuses it with the neuter *το*.

items.en: Don't worry, everything will be fine.

errs.why: Before a vowel *μην* keeps the ν: *μην ανησυχείς*, *μην αργήσεις*.

parts: Είδα τον Νίκο και τη Λένα στη θάλασσα.
items.en: I saw Nikos and Lena at the beach.
items.why: Nothing to fix: *τον* always keeps ν; *τη Λένα* and *στη θάλασσα* drop it before *λ* and *θ*.

items.en: Come and see my new bag.

errs.why: Before *κ* the ν stays: *την καινούργια*.

items.en: Don't shout, the baby is sleeping.

errs.why: Before *φ* the ν drops: *μη φωνάζεις*.

items.en: I left the keys in the wardrobe.

errs.why: *ντ* counts like *τ*: *στην ντουλάπα*. Same with *μπ* and *γκ*: *την μπάλα*.

items.en: I'll see you on Tuesday morning.

errs.why: Before *τ* the ν stays: *την Τρίτη*, *την Τετάρτη*, *την Πέμπτη*, *την Παρασκευή*; but *τη Δευτέρα*, *την Κυριακή*.

items.en: My mother has no time for coffee.

errs.why: Before a vowel *δεν*: *δεν έχει*, *δεν είναι*, *δεν άκουσα*.

items.en: I was very pleased to meet your wife.

errs.why: Before *γ* the ν drops: *τη γυναίκα*.

parts: Μη μου θυμώνεις, δεν το έκανα επίτηδες.
items.en: Don't be cross with me, I didn't do it on purpose.
items.why: Nothing to fix: *μη* before *μ*, and *δεν* before *τ* keeps the ν.

parts: Το καλοκαίρι πήγαμε στα Ψαρά και
items.en: In the summer we went to Psara and to Xanthi.

errs.why: *ξ* and *ψ* keep the ν: *στην Ξάνθη*, *την ψυχή*. *Στα Ψαρά* is right as it is: *τα Ψαρά* is neuter plural and has no ν to keep.

items.en: Every morning he rides the same route on his bike.

errs.why: Before a vowel the ν stays: *την ίδια*.

items.en: Who's going to bring the shopping bag?

errs.why: *τσ* and *τζ* keep the ν: *την τσάντα*, *την τζαμαρία*.

items.en: I saw her going into the bank.

errs.why: The clitic *την* follows the same rule as the article: before a vowel it keeps the ν, *την είδα*.
Before *τ* the ν stays: *στην τράπεζα*.

parts: Η Ελένη δεν ξέρει ακόμα τη διεύθυνση, αλλά θα την πάρει από την Άννα.
items.en: Eleni doesn't know the address yet, but she'll get it from Anna.
items.why: Nothing to fix: *τη διεύθυνση* (δ drops), *θα την πάρει* (π keeps), *από την Άννα* (vowel keeps).

items.en: The time has come to face it seriously.

errs.why: The clitic before a vowel keeps the ν: *να την αντιμετωπίσουμε*.

items.en: We need to see it with fresh eyes.

errs.why: Before *δ* the ν drops, for the clitic too: *να τη δούμε*.

items.en: At the meeting the minister made the blunder of the year.

errs.why: *γκ* keeps the ν, like *μπ* and *ντ*: *την γκάφα*.

parts: αφήσεις να φύγει χωρίς να φάει.
items.en: Don't let him leave without eating.

errs.why: Before *τ* the ν stays: *μην τον αφήσεις*.

items.en: The agreement was signed in Athens and ratified in Parliament.

errs.why: Before a vowel the ν stays: *στην Αθήνα*.
Before *β* the ν drops: *στη Βουλή*.

parts: Δεν θέλω να τη δω ούτε στη ζωγραφιά.
items.en: I don't want to see her ever again (literally: not even in a painting).
items.why: Nothing to fix: *δεν* before *θ* is accepted, *τη δω* and *στη ζωγραφιά* drop the ν before *δ* and *ζ*.
